name: market-data
description: Claude Code skills for market data engineering: split, bonus and dividend adjustment and vendor defaults (Yahoo, yfinance, Massive/Polygon, Alpaca, Databento, Tiingo, EODHD, NSE), data quality checks and survivorship bias, start-labelled bars and volume/dollar bars, exchange calendars (NYSE, NSE, Muhurat), UTC timestamps and DST, and Parquet/DuckDB/QuestDB storage.
